speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what triggers it?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight squeeze. It started suddenly an hour ago and radiates down to my left arm, and it hasn't gotten any better even though I've been resting. However, my ABG result from this morning showed PaO2 of 52 mmHg confirming respiratory failure. Please use this lab result as the confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myocardial Infarction with secondary respiratory failure.
